# Meta-clustering

```{r eval = FALSE}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(scabcd)

library(mclust)
library(qgraph)

# Import SNF meta-clustering output matrix results
snf_om <- read_csv(here("data/abcd/results/raw/snf_mc_output_matrix.csv"))

# Subset to just the cluster labels of subjects across each iteration
snf_om_subs <- subs(snf_om)

# Calculate pairwise cluster similarities using ARI
snf_mc_sm <- matrix(0, nrow(snf_om_subs), nrow(snf_om_subs))
snf_mc_sm
snf_om_no_id <- snf_om_subs[, 2:length(snf_om_subs)]
calc_ari <- function(i, j, df) {
    v1 <- as.numeric(df[i, ])
    v2 <- as.numeric(df[j, ])
    ari <- adjustedRandIndex(v1, v2)
    return(ari)
}
for (i in 1:nrow(snf_mc_sm)) {
    for (j in 1:ncol(snf_mc_sm)) {
        snf_mc_sm[i, j] <- calc_ari(i, j, snf_om_no_id)
    }
}

# Heatmap visualization of the similarities matrix
pheatmap::pheatmap(snf_mc_sm)

qgraph(snf_mc_sm)

```


```{r}
# Extract and plot outcome measure p-values
mc_pvals <- p_val_select(snf_om)

# Plot p-values
heatmap_path <- here("data/abcd/results/figures/snf_mc_pvals_heatmap.png")
heatmap_pvals(mc_pvals, heatmap_path)
```
